hypotheses.reasoning: At 13:21:03 notification-svc v3.13.0 rolled out with config revision 645. At 13:21:28 the config reload changed TEMPLATE_SVC_URL to port 8081. From 13:21:59 on, every render call fails with ECONNREFUSED on 10.17.189.215:8081. template-svc itself logs no errors, so it is still up, just not listening on that port. The gateway 503s that triggered the alert follow from these failures. The notif-worker deploy, the audit_log slow query and the provider reset at 13:10 are unrelated.
The fault is a wrong endpoint value. If revision 645 was pushed from config-service on its own rather than as part of the release, this counts as config_error.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back notification-svc to the previous release / config revision, restoring TEMPLATE_SVC_URL to template-svc's real port. Then add an endpoint check to the deploy pipeline.
